item.title: The Grammys Have Never Won a Top Program Emmy: Could This Be the Year?
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we're talking about the latest news in the entertainment world. Today, we're focusing on the Grammy Awards and their recent Emmy nomination. Let's dive in!"
[Music transitions]
Host: "The 2026 Grammy Awards telecast has been nominated for a Primetime Emmy for Outstanding Variety Special (Live). This is the 10th time the annual Grammy telecast has been nominated in this category. However, they have yet to take home the top prize, losing to other prestigious awards shows like the Oscars and the Tonys in the past."
[Short music break]
Host: "This year, the Grammys are up against some tough competition, including the Oscars, the Tonys, the Golden Globes, and The Apple Music Super Bowl LX Halftime Show Starring Bad Bunny. Interestingly, Bad Bunny was also a big part of the Grammy telecast, winning two on-air awards and being a central figure in a recurring bit with host Trevor Noah."
[Music transitions]
Host: "Some notable producers are also double nominees this year, including Jesse Collins, Raj Kapoor, Glenn Weiss, and Ricky Kirshner, who worked on multiple nominated shows. And speaking of hosts, Trevor Noah has been a good luck charm for the Grammys, with four of the six telecasts he hosted being nominated for the top program Emmy. However, he's announced that he won't be returning to host next year's show, so we'll have to wait and see who takes his place."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's podcast. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll be keeping an eye on the Emmy Awards to see if the Grammys can finally take home the top prize."
